title: Which AppProtection capabilities depend on the subscription

prose.text: Some of the console is shown only for some subscriptions. {{browser-protection-option}} {{browser-protection-page}}

prose.label: What is not documented.
prose.text: What Browser Protection adds beyond baseline AppProtection, and the tier names that gate it, are open {{gap:tier-entitlement}}. That the default profile ships with every account is in [[zpa.appprotection.profiles]]; whether the rest of AppProtection needs a separate SKU is open {{gap:baseline-bundling}}.

checks.do: Whether the Browser Protection option appears on the AppProtection Policy page of the tenant.

browser-protection-option.statement: Depending on the AppProtection subscription, the AppProtection Policy page shows a Browser Protection security policy option.

quotes: Depending on your AppProtection subscription, you see the following Security policy option: Browser Protection.

browser-protection-page.statement: The AppProtection profiles page links to a Browser Protection page for Browser Protection profiles.

quotes: Go to the Browser Protection page to view and manage your Browser Protection profiles.

tier-entitlement.title: What Browser Protection unlocks and which tiers carry it
tier-entitlement.detail: Unverified legacy statement: "Browser Protection — tier-gated, separate subscription consideration" and "Possibly other tier-gated capabilities not captured (ThreatLabZ controls, advanced Active Directory protection, custom-rule limits, etc.)". The help says only that the option appears depending on the subscription. Tier names (Business, Transformation, Workplace+) are not in the captures. The account team confirms entitlement for a tenant.

baseline-bundling.title: Whether baseline AppProtection is bundled with ZPA
baseline-bundling.detail: Unverified legacy statement: "AppProtection appears bundled with ZPA ... the help docs don't gate basic AppProtection behind a separate SKU." The help says a default profile is included with account setup; it does not state a licensing position.
